parts.text: As a dispatcher, my job is to plan and run the flights, deciding which drone flies and along which way, and I am the licensed person responsible for signing off a flight before it leaves. I can call off a flight, and while our company policy is that software never chooses a drone or a way for us, I do want help finding out which of our drones could get to where a job starts. Several of us plan at the same time, often for the same busy sites and popular drones, and nobody steers a drone with a stick through this service because they fly on their own autopilots. I don't know the full step-by-step process of every single thing from start to finish beyond what I've mentioned, as my notes don't walk through a complete chronological sequence of a flight.
